## Summary and hook scope

Describe the exact versions, package/process scope, hooked method, and reason for the change.

## Safety and validation

- [ ] Package, process, version, and signer guards are minimal and fail closed
- [ ] No Xposed API stub is packaged
- [ ] Static safety tests and Java/Apktool builds pass
- [ ] Activation and target behavior were verified with sanitized evidence
- [ ] Disable/uninstall rollback was verified
- [ ] No proprietary code/binary, key, token, private data, database, serial, or raw log is included
